Watch the manoj muntashir latest poetry video on rashmirathi; epic poetry by ramdhari singh dinkar. Rashmirathi is a masterpiece written by the legendary poet ramdhari singh dinkar. This is the recitation of the 3rd part (Teesra Sarg) of rashmirathi. Rashmirathi by Ramdhari Singh Dinkar is based on characters of Mahabharat. This video is a must watch for fan of manoj muntashir, rashmirathi, ramdhari singh dinkar and hindi poetry.
